name: Use decimal.Decimal for money, never float
description: Floats cannot represent 0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3 exactly. Any monetary, accounting, or invoicing code must use decimal.Decimal with explicit precision and rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN is the standard for finance).

name: datetime.utcnow() is deprecated in Python 3.12+
description: It returns a naive datetime, leading to silent timezone bugs. Use datetime.now(timezone.utc) instead, which returns an aware datetime and survives DST and serialization correctly.

name: Prefer asyncio.TaskGroup over asyncio.gather (3.11+)
description: TaskGroup gives structured concurrency: child task exceptions cancel siblings and propagate cleanly. gather() drops sibling-cancellation guarantees and is harder to reason about.

name: subprocess with shell=True is a security risk on user input
description: shell=True invokes a shell which expands metacharacters in arguments. Always pass a list of arguments and shell=False (the default), and never interpolate untrusted input into a shell string.

name: logging.basicConfig is a no-op after the first call
description: If any code calls logging anywhere before basicConfig, basicConfig silently does nothing. To force reconfiguration, pass force=True (3.8+) or remove existing handlers from the root logger first.

name: json.dumps does not sort keys by default
description: Round-tripping the same dict can produce different strings, breaking content hashes and diffs. Pass sort_keys=True for stable, reproducible output.

name: pathlib.Path.read_text default encoding is platform-dependent
description: On Windows it can be cp1252 if the locale is not UTF-8. Always pass encoding='utf-8' explicitly when reading files written by your code or shipped in a repository.

name: functools.lru_cache is unbounded by default
description: lru_cache(maxsize=None) is the default in 3.2+ which means it grows forever. For long-running processes always set an explicit maxsize, or use functools.cache only for small key spaces.

name: Use 'is None' instead of '== None'
description: PEP 8 mandates identity comparison for None. Some custom classes override __eq__ such that 'x == None' returns True even when x is not None, leading to subtle bugs.

name: ThreadPoolExecutor must be closed or used as a context manager
description: If shutdown() is not called, dangling threads can prevent the program from exiting. Always use 'with ThreadPoolExecutor(...) as executor:' or call .shutdown(wait=True).

name: shutil.copytree dirs_exist_ok added in 3.8
description: Before 3.8 copytree raised on an existing destination. From 3.8 you can pass dirs_exist_ok=True to merge into an existing tree. On older versions you must remove the destination first.

name: dict.get vs dict[key] semantic difference
description: dict.get returns None (or a default) for missing keys; dict[key] raises KeyError. Use [] when missing-key is a bug you want to surface; use .get when missing is a normal case with a fallback.

name: list.sort is in-place; sorted returns a new list
description: list.sort() returns None and mutates the list. sorted(iterable) returns a new list and works on any iterable. Confusing them silently breaks chaining: my_list = my_list.sort() leaves my_list as None.

name: concurrent.futures.as_completed yields in completion order
description: Yields futures as they finish, not in submission order. If you need results in submission order, iterate over the original future list and call .result() on each, or use map() instead of submit().

name: Use contextlib.suppress for cleanly ignored exceptions
description: Replaces 'try: ... except SomeError: pass' with the more readable 'with suppress(SomeError): ...'. Importantly, suppress only catches exceptions raised inside the with block, not setup or teardown.

name: argparse.BooleanOptionalAction adds --no-foo automatically (3.9+)
description: Removes the need to write a custom store_false action paired with store_true. Use action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction to get --foo and --no-foo for free.

name: secrets module supersedes random for tokens
description: random is seeded predictably and is not cryptographically secure. For passwords, tokens, session IDs, and anything an adversary could guess from output, use secrets.token_urlsafe / secrets.token_hex / secrets.choice.

name: Avoid mutable default arguments
description: def f(items=[]): the default list is created once and shared across all calls — mutations leak. Use def f(items=None): items = items or [] instead. Same trap with dicts and sets.

name: concurrent.futures.ProcessPoolExecutor pickles arguments
description: Functions and arguments must be picklable, which rules out closures, lambdas, and many class methods. If pickling fails the error message is often opaque — debug by trying to pickle.dumps the call manually.

name: tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile delete behavior on Windows
description: On Windows the file cannot be reopened by another process while open if delete=True (the default). Pass delete=False and remove the file manually to support cross-platform code that re-opens its own temp files.
